_comment: Fetched by the app at startup from the main branch; also embedded at build time as the offline default. Edit it to adapt to YouTube changes without shipping a new build.

playerFallback._comment: Pre-playerClients builds only. Used when the player client fails or has no direct URLs. Its stream URLs carry the n throttling parameter (and sometimes signatureCipher): the core deciphers them by running the TV player JS (QuickJS + yt-dlp EJS). Empty clientName disables it.

playerClients._comment: Candidate from yt-dlp's android_vr client (direct URLs). Untested here: check with CLIENT=ANDROID_VR ./ytcheck <id> 1, then enable.

browse._comment: Signed-in feeds (Bearer token): only the TV client accepts it.

search._comment: Signed-out search. clientVersion is read from youtube.com when possible; this is the fallback.
search.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0 Safari/537.36

oauth._comment: Google device flow with the YouTube TV app's client. The pair is normally read from youtube.com/tv; the fallback is the public pair last seen in that bundle (2026-10-10).

returnYouTubeDislike._comment: Like / dislike estimates shown under the player title.

reports._comment: Bug reports: the QR code opens a pre-filled issue in updates.repo. When the user attaches the full log, it is posted to `paste` (OmegaTube's own Worker, see github.com/IIyn/omegatube-logs) as the raw text/plain body, or as a form with the text in `field` plus `params` when `field` is set; the service must answer with the report's https URL. Empty `paste`: no "Attach the full log" button.
